temporal_state_chain.observed: Ethan notices Gary working excessively long hours at the hospital, skipping meals, and sacrificing sleep. When Ethan invites him to a weekend retreat, Gary declines, saying there is too much to do at the hospital.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is dedicated but dangerously overworked and neglecting his health; he thinks a retreat could help Gary relax and gain perspective.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Gary's refusal confirms that hospital work is currently overwhelming him and preventing him from accepting a break.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary is severely overcommitted at the hospital and currently unable or unwilling to step away, even though he needs rest.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, worried, and disappointed for Gary.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue supporting Gary and find another way to help him address his overwork and health.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During the retreat, Ethan observes Gary acting restless and avoiding discussions about work. When Ethan confronts him, Gary says the situation is complicated and that he did not want to burden Ethan with his problems.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is overworked and stressed by hospital demands, and he hopes the retreat will help Gary relax, but Gary remains guarded.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Gary's restlessness, avoidance, and 'complicated' response suggest the overwork is tied to deeper personal issues, not just professional obligations.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes there is more behind Gary's overwork than hospital duties and that Gary is carrying personal burdens he has been hiding.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To encourage Gary to open up and to offer nonjudgmental help and support.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Gary opens up about the pressures of managing a new department and personal challenges he is facing. He accepts Ethan's suggestion to prioritize tasks, delegate responsibilities, and organize his schedule.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary's overwork is driven by deeper personal and professional struggles, though he does not yet know the specifics.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Gary's disclosure clarifies the reasons for his overwork - new department pressures and personal challenges - and shows he is willing to accept help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary's overwork stems from concrete work and personal pressures, and that Gary can find better balance with support, prioritization, and delegation.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Gary prioritize tasks, delegate responsibilities, and build a healthier schedule and work-life balance.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over the following months, Ethan checks in with Gary about his progress and challenges. Gary reports feeling less overwhelmed and says he had time for a movie last weekend.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is capable of improving and is willing to work toward better balance with support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes, it reinforces his belief: Gary's ongoing efforts and reported improvements show that the support is helping and that Gary is making real progress.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary is actively improving, managing stress better, and moving toward a healthier work-life balance.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue checking in, offering encouragement, and supporting Gary's progress.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After a year, Gary has successfully adjusted to a healthier work-life balance and says he feels more in control. Ethan tells Gary he is always available but that Gary has got this.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary has been improving and benefiting from support, but may still need ongoing encouragement.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Gary's sustained adjustment and sense of control show that he can now manage independently.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Ethan believes Gary is capable of maintaining a healthier balance on his own and no longer needs active intervention.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Satisfied, happy, proud, and relieved for Gary.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To step back from active support while remaining available if Gary ever needs him.
